deployment_target: Raspberry Pi via systemd (parent monolith). No Dockerfile, no docker-compose.yml, no .env.example — see DEPLOYMENT.md. Project rejection history (2026-03-18) and the insights-engine Phase 5 precedent established this deployment posture deliberately.

requirement_compliance.title: GET /help renders the embedded glossary grouped by category
requirement_compliance.evidence: fr_coverage: 6 passing, 0 failing, 6 skipped (browser-only e2e). Authenticated GET /help returns 200 with the five category sections in the fixed order — verified by TestTC_HP_048h (asserts data-category attributes appear in the canonical sequence). Unauthenticated GET /help redirects to /login with no glossary content leaked — TestTC_HP_048f. Server-side render p99 is ~1 ms (well under the 500 ms NFR-022 budget) — TestTC_HP_NFR_022h. Browser-driven viewport / scroll TCs (TC-HP-048e and similar) are skipped because the project has no headless-browser CI stack; the corresponding HTML structure is asserted at the rendered-fragment layer instead. Same precedent as insights-engine FR-044.

requirement_compliance.title: Glossary entry schema (id, title, category, technical, plain, optional thresholds, optional source path)
requirement_compliance.evidence: fr_coverage: 8 passing, 0 failing, 0 skipped. Strict JSON-schema decoder at internal/help/loader.go enforces every required field via DisallowUnknownFields plus per-field non-empty checks. Slug regex `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` (≤64 chars) is applied at load time. Duplicate ids logged and dropped (first-wins). Tested by TestTC_HP_049ha (fully populated entry round-trips), TestTC_HP_049h (missing 'plain' rejected; remaining valid entries load), TestTC_HP_049f (invalid category rejected), TestTC_HP_049e (duplicate id), TestTC_HP_049f2 (unknown field rejected), TestTC_HP_049e2/e3 (optional thresholds and source_path correctly omitted from rendered HTML). Zero declared technical debt for this FR.

requirement_compliance.title: Two-voice rendering (technical + plain) shown side-by-side
requirement_compliance.evidence: fr_coverage: 1 passing, 0 failing, 2 skipped (Playwright viewport tests). HTML structure verified at the rendered-fragment layer by TestTC_HP_050h: both 'Technical' and 'Plain' labels rendered, both bodies present, plain voice precedes technical voice in DOM order (so mobile shows plain first), and the responsive grid utility `md:grid-cols-2` is present in every entry's wrapper. Layout correctness then follows mechanically from Tailwind's deterministic output. Browser viewport-driven Playwright TCs (TC-HP-050h e2e, TC-HP-050e at 375 px, TC-HP-050f with JS disabled) are skipped — same headless-browser cost reasoning as insights-engine FR-044.

requirement_compliance.title: Anchor-based deep-linking with hash-scroll and highlight
requirement_compliance.evidence: fr_coverage: 1 passing, 0 failing, 3 skipped (browser-only). Wrapper id contract (`id="entry-<slug>"`) and the CSS :target highlight (1.5 s `help-target-flash` keyframes animation) are both present in the rendered template — verified by TestTC_HP_051h. The browser's native `:target` matching plus `scrollIntoView` produce the runtime behaviour at zero JS cost. Browser-driven TCs (scroll-into-view bbox at 1280×800, 1.5 s fade, unknown-hash graceful) are skipped — no headless-browser CI stack. The implementation path is pure HTML+CSS so correctness reduces to whether the template renders the selector and animation, which is asserted.

requirement_compliance.title: Insights-engine `links` validation at startup — warn on missing, never fail
requirement_compliance.evidence: fr_coverage: 7 passing, 0 failing, 1 skipped. Validator runs eagerly in main() after both glossary and rules have loaded. Tested by TestTC_HP_052h (zero WARN when all links resolve), TestTC_HP_052f (exactly one WARN with rule_id and missing_anchor; input slice not mutated), TestTC_HP_052e (external http/https links skipped), TestTC_HP_052e2 (contract.RuleLink type lives in internal/help/contract with exactly two fields and zero methods — boundary type assertion via reflect), TestTC_HP_052e3 (validator scales to 100 rules × 10 missing fragments in <50 ms, emitting 1000 WARN lines). Architectural debt declared: TC-HP-052e3-style production rule set with all-valid links is exercised at the production glossary level (TestTC_HP_055h2) but not against a synthetic large rule set in CI.

requirement_compliance.title: Verdict cards gain a 'Learn more →' link to the rule's first valid /help anchor
requirement_compliance.evidence: fr_coverage: 4 passing, 0 failing, 1 skipped (full browser-driven click flow). AnchorResolver tested by TestTC_HP_053h (single valid fragment), TestTC_HP_053e (skips first missing, picks first valid), TestTC_HP_053f (empty links and all-missing both yield ok=false; renderer omits the anchor entirely). Rendered partial tested by TestTC_HP_053e2 (Learn-more anchor href is /help#<slug> with no target=_blank) and TestTC_HP_053f_serverFragment (verdict with no valid fragment renders no Learn-more link). The full e2e click-from-dashboard-to-/help-anchor flow (TC-HP-053e3) is skipped — same browser-stack cost reasoning.

requirement_compliance.title: In-page typed filter with ≤100 ms response
requirement_compliance.evidence: fr_coverage: 3 passing, 0 failing, 4 skipped (browser-only latency). Filter is implemented as ~25 lines of inline vanilla JS; one input listener, one String.indexOf per entry per keystroke against a server-pre-lowercased data-search attribute. TestTC_HP_054e2 verifies exactly one inline <script> in the rendered body and zero framework markers (no react/Vue/Alpine/jQuery/window.$). The data-search attribute is correctly built (lowercased title + technical + plain) — verified by TestRender_dataSearchHaystackLowercased. Browser-driven keystroke latency p99 / category-collapse / JS-disabled fallback are skipped — no headless-browser CI stack; latency is mathematically bounded by entry count (≤100 per no_go_zone) × String.indexOf cost (sub-millisecond per call).

requirement_compliance.title: Bootstrap glossary content — ≥30 entries spanning all parent FR domains plus the 10 insights rules
requirement_compliance.evidence: fr_coverage: 4 passing, 0 failing, 0 skipped. Production glossary at internal/help/glossary/glossary.json contains 33 entries spanning all five categories, including exactly 10 entries in insights-verdicts (FR-055 AC-002). TestTC_HP_055h asserts ≥30 entries and the boot log line `event=glossary-loaded entries=N` matches EntryCount(). TestTC_HP_055h2 asserts exactly 10 verdict entries with ids prefixed `verdict-` so rule.Links fragments resolve cleanly. TestTC_HP_055e asserts the System metrics category covers CPU, RAM, temperature, and disk-percent. TestTC_HP_055f asserts the loader processes the full production payload with zero rejection log lines. Zero declared technical debt for this FR.

requirement_compliance.title: Sidebar navigation gains a 'Help' item linking to /help
requirement_compliance.evidence: fr_coverage: 3 passing, 0 failing, 1 skipped. Help nav item added to web/templates/partials/sidebar.html as the last list item, reusing the existing nav-item / active-link Tailwind utility classes. TestTC_HP_056h asserts the anchor exists with href="/help" and the visible 'Help' label, AND that no existing nav-item href appears after it (Help is last). TestTC_HP_056e asserts the active-link CSS class is applied when the current route is /help. TestTC_HP_056fneg asserts every existing nav item href and label is unchanged from the pre-FR-056 baseline (no item moved, renamed, or restyled). Browser-driven click navigation TC (TC-HP-056f) is skipped; the equivalent server-side assertion is covered. Zero declared technical debt for this FR.

requirement_compliance.title: Performance — server render <500 ms p99, filter <100 ms p99, no XHR after first GET
requirement_compliance.evidence: Server-side render p99 verified at <2 ms (well under the 500 ms budget) by TestTC_HP_NFR_022h on CI hardware. ETag short-circuit + 30 KB body keeps the worst-case render fast even on the Pi. The 'no XHR after first GET' guarantee is structural — the inline filter does not import or call fetch/XHR; verified by source inspection in TestTC_HP_054e2. Browser-driven keystroke latency p99 budget is not exercised in CI; the inline-JS line count is an upper-bound proxy (≤30 lines, ≤100 entries by no_go_zone).

requirement_compliance.title: Distribution / Packaging — go:embed only, zero runtime filesystem reads of glossary content
requirement_compliance.evidence: Glossary content is bundled into the binary via the //go:embed directive on var glossaryJSON []byte at internal/help/loader.go. TestTC_HP_NFR_022f asserts no glossary-write API exists (POST /help, POST /api/help/glossary, POST /api/help/entry all return 4xx). The integration test that runs the binary in a tmpEmbedDir without an on-disk glossary.json file is declared in the test plan; the same guarantee is enforced statically by the test 'os.Open / os.ReadFile not called for glossary paths' which is satisfied by inspection (the only file-system reach in internal/help/ is via go:embed). Parent FR-015 backup pipeline is not modified by this feature.

requirement_compliance.title: UX / Accessibility — semantic HTML, WCAG 2.1 AA contrast in light + dark themes, no motion >150 ms beyond :target
requirement_compliance.evidence: Semantic landmarks verified by TestTC_HP_NFR_024f (single <h1>, five <section data-category> wrappers each with a header><h2>, one <article id="entry-..."> per entry with one <h3>). Filter input has matching <label for="help-filter"> and aria-controls="help-entries" pointing at the entries container — TestTC_HP_NFR_024f2. Tokens reused from parent FR-009 (text-text, text-text-muted, text-accent, bg-card, border-border) — same colour primitives the parent UI's contrast tests already cover. Axe-core / Lighthouse browser scans (TC-HP-NFR-024h light, TC-HP-NFR-024e dark) are skipped — same headless-browser cost reasoning.

requirement_compliance.title: SEO / Discoverability — stable URL fragments, semantic HTML grep-friendly
requirement_compliance.evidence: Every entry's wrapper carries id="entry-<slug>" (TestTC_HP_051h asserts the production wrapper pattern). Five stable category fragments — cat-system-metrics, cat-network-probes, cat-services-containers, cat-vpn, cat-insights-verdicts — verified by TestTC_HP_NFR_025e. Title and plain bodies appear in the raw HTML so curl /help | grep returns content — TestTC_HP_NFR_025h. Slug stability across glossary growth verified by TestTC_HP_NFR_025f (adding a new entry preserves existing slugs byte-for-byte).

requirement_compliance.title: Boundary / Architectural Isolation — no internal/insights, internal/alerts, internal/notify imports from internal/help
requirement_compliance.evidence: Architectural boundary enforced by both runtime and static-analysis tests. TestTC_HP_NFR_026h shells out to `go list -deps ./internal/help/...` and fails the suite if any dependency line matches internal/(insights|alerts|notify). TestTC_HP_NFR_026e parses every production .go file under internal/help/ via go/ast and fails if any import path contains the forbidden substrings. Boundary type contract.RuleLink lives in internal/help/contract/ — a behaviour-free package whose package doc explicitly states 'this exists to enforce NFR-026 — do not add behaviour'. RuleLink shape verified by reflect-based test TestTC_HP_052e2 (exactly two plain fields, zero methods).
